governance_note: Threshold-only extraction from executable source/config. No model execution was performed to produce this file.

roi_proposal_threshold.role: Bounding box from p_global >= 0.30; empty ROI -> ACTION_UNAVAILABLE -> FORCED_SKIP.

router_utility_transformation.role: Resource-aware utility used by the B_phi runtime gate.

router_runtime_threshold_tau_C8_final.role: DEPLOYED runtime threshold: EXECUTE iff U >= tau_C8_final.

router_oof_scientific_threshold.role: SEPARATE score space used for scientific evidence only. NEVER a runtime gate. Overlap of OOF-vs-final decision IDs is 1086/1239, so the two spaces MUST NOT be conflated.

router_decision.definition: B_phi gate decision. EXECUTE iff U(delta_hat_final) >= tau_C8_final, else SKIP.

definitions.FORCED_SKIP: ROI proposal empty (ACTION_UNAVAILABLE). Router and refiner are never invoked; global prediction is the final output.
definitions.SKIP_GLOBAL: Router decided SKIP. Global prediction is the final output.
definitions.EXECUTE_THEN_ACCEPT: Router decided EXECUTE, R_psi refined, S_omega accepted. Refined/fused prediction is the final output.
definitions.EXECUTE_THEN_REJECT: Router decided EXECUTE, R_psi refined, S_omega rejected. Fall back to the global prediction as the final output.

key_distinction: router_decision (SKIP/EXECUTE) is the B_phi gate outcome and is DISTINCT from the four-state final state. FORCED_SKIP is decided BEFORE the router (empty proposal), so it has no router_decision of its own.
